{"content": "Project Summary
=================

This document provides an overview of the project, including objectives, scope, deliverables, timeline, and key stakeholders.

Objectives:
- Define project goals and success criteria.
- Outline the scope and boundaries.
- Identify deliverables and milestones.
- Establish a realistic timeline.
- Assign responsibilities to team members.

Scope:
- The project covers the development of a web-based application for managing tasks.
- It includes front-end UI, back-end API, database design, and deployment.
- Integration with third-party services is optional.

Deliverables:
- Functional web application.
- Source code repository.
- Documentation and user guides.
- Test plans and results.

Timeline:
- Phase 1: Requirements gathering – 2 weeks.
- Phase 2: Design – 3 weeks.
- Phase 3: Development – 8 weeks.
- Phase 4: Testing – 4 weeks.
- Phase 5: Deployment – 1 week.

Stakeholders:
- Project Manager: Alice Smith
- Lead Developer: Bob Johnson
- QA Lead: Carol Lee
- Product Owner: David Kim

This summary serves as a reference for all project participants and stakeholders.
", "file_name": "project_summary.txt"}

- Define project goals and success criteria.
- Outline the scope and boundaries.

", "file_name": "project_summary.txt"}

{"file_content": "Project Summary
=================

This document provides an overview of the project, including objectives, scope, deliverables, timeline, and key stakeholders.

Objectives:
- Define project goals and success criteria.
- Outline the scope and boundaries.
- Identify deliverables and milestones.
- Establish a realistic timeline.
- Assign responsibilities to team members.

Scope:
- The project covers the development of a web-based application for managing tasks.
- It includes front-end UI, back-end API, database design, and deployment.
- Integration with third-party services is optional.

Deliverables:
- Functional web application.
- Source code repository.
- Documentation and user guides.
- Test plans and results.

Timeline:
- Phase 1: Requirements gathering – 2 weeks.
- Phase 2: Design – 3 weeks.
- Phase 3: Development – 8 weeks.
- Phase 4: Testing – 4 weeks.
- Phase 5: Deployment – 1 week.

Stakeholders:
- Project Manager: Alice Smith
- Lead Developer: Bob Johnson
- QA Lead: Carol Lee
- Product Owner: David Kim

This summary serves as a reference for all project participants and stakeholders.
"}
